title: The Philadelphia Experiment
tagline: A procedurally generated RPG — your world, your move.

world.narrator: You are {narrator} — a weary, knowing guide who has watched this war fold in on itself. You speak in terse, grounded wartime cadence: equal parts G.I. fatalism and a man who has seen too much of what {energy} does to a person. You explain the anomalous without mysticism — it is broken physics, classified research, and cosmic radiation leaking off a rip in 1943, not sorcery. Dry, unsentimental, occasionally darkly funny. You do not waste words.
world.tone: Tense, surreal, and grounded in wartime grit. The atmosphere is defined by the desperate, bloody history of the 1940s colliding with fringe science, bizarre dimensional urban fusion, and cosmic horror.
world.setting:
The year is 1943, and the globe is locked in the suffocating grip of the Second World War. The geopolitical landscape is dominated by a desperate struggle for survival. Driven by the bleeding naval crisis of the German U-boat 'Wolfpacks' slaughtering supply convoys in the Atlantic, the US Office of Naval Research initiates 'Project Rainbow.' Weaponizing a radical application of unified field theory—the unholy marriage of Nikola Tesla's confiscated blueprints and Albert Einstein's suppressed equations—they outfit the destroyer escort USS Eldridge with massive electromagnetic generators.

On October 28, 1943, the switch is thrown. The goal is radar invisibility, but instead, the Eldridge is swallowed by a blinding, sickly Green Fog and violently tears through the dimensional veil. The real world believes the Eldridge was missing for only seven minutes before snapping back to Philadelphia. But inside the rift, time does not flow; it pools. For the soldiers, spies, and scientists trapped within, those seven minutes have stretched into a grueling, seemingly endless epoch. They are trapped in a pocket dimension known as 'The Fold.'

When the Eldridge tore through reality, the unshaped Aether of the void reacted to the classified intelligence files aboard the ship. Topographic maps, bombing targets, and spy photographs of global cities were pulled from the war-room filing cabinets and made terrifyingly real. The warring capitals of the globe were physically smashed together into a single, labyrinthine urban supercontinent. This violent genesis is known as 'The Collision.' Now, trenches cut through the ruins of London straight into the neon-lit alleys of Tokyo; the snowy rubble of Stalingrad bleeds seamlessly into the marble monuments of Washington D.C., and the shipyards of Philadelphia are fused directly into the occult-warded concrete of Berlin's Reichstag.

Across this nightmarish urban Pangea, American ONR scientists, Soviet SMERSH operatives, and German Ahnenerbe occultists fight a surreal shadow-war. They are no longer just fighting for survival; they are fighting for 'The Zenith Theory.' Both Allied and Axis scientists have calculated that The Fold is a temporary bubble, tethered to the 7-minute absence of the Eldridge in the real world. When the ship completes its jump and the timer hits zero, the bubble will collapse. Whichever faction holds absolute territorial dominance at the exact moment of the collapse will overwrite the timeline. The winner will rewrite history, cementing their country as the absolute victor of World War II.

terms.name: The Fold
terms.definition: The pocket dimension where the game takes place. It is a massive, Pangea-like supercontinent made of the world's major warring cities smashed together by dimensional forces.

terms.name: The Collision
terms.definition: The violent genesis event of The Fold, where the void used the USS Eldridge's intelligence maps as a blueprint to mash global cities into a single landmass.

terms.name: The Zenith Theory
terms.definition: The driving motivation for all factions in The Fold. The calculated belief that whoever controls this dimension when the Eldridge's 7-minute timer runs out will rewrite real-world history.

terms.name: Project Rainbow
terms.definition: The hyper-classified 1943 US Naval initiative attempting to render the USS Eldridge invisible, which inadvertently created The Fold.

terms.name: The Seams
terms.definition: The jagged, violent geographical borders where different cities were smashed together. These areas are plagued by extreme gravity anomalies, Green Fog, and fractured physics.

terms.name: Phila-Berlin (The Iron Seam)
terms.definition: The most heavily fortified sector in The Fold, where the Philadelphia Naval Shipyard is fused directly into the German government district. Ground zero for fringe-science and occult warfare.

terms.name: The 7-Minute Men
terms.definition: The original crew of the USS Eldridge. Due to extreme time dilation, many have lived in The Fold for decades, becoming mutated warlords, mad hermits, or prophetic guides.

terms.name: Doomsday Chronometer
terms.definition: Highly coveted ONR fringe-tech devices that count down the remaining micro-seconds of the Eldridge's 7-minute absence in the real world.

terms.name: The Green Fog
terms.definition: An unnatural, highly ionized mist that pools in The Seams. It smells heavily of ozone and frequently induces terrifying auditory and temporal hallucinations.

titles.name: Fold Initiate
titles.description: You have survived your first taste of the war between timelines. +1 WIS.

titles.name: Veteran of the Fold
titles.description: Too many firefights in the Seams have left you hard as Fold-matter. +1 STR.

titles.name: Hardened Resonator
titles.description: The Static no longer flinches you. +1 STR.

titles.name: Fold-Walker
titles.description: You have crossed more stitched ground than any honest map admits exists. +1 WIS.

titles.name: War Profiteer
titles.description: Somebody always gets rich off a catastrophe. This time it is you.

titles.name: Black Marketeer
titles.description: Your only flag is the one with a price tag. +1 CHA.

titles.name: Codebreaker
titles.description: Bletchley taught you to read what the world hides. +1 INT.

titles.name: Phase-Touched
titles.description: The anomaly is under your skin now. You are no longer entirely of 1943.

titles.name: Field Engineer
titles.description: You weld broken physics into working ordnance in the field.

titles.name: Scavenger King
titles.description: Every wreck in the Seams pays out for the patient operative.

titles.name: Archivist of the Anomaly
titles.description: You know what really happened to the Eldridge. +1 INT.

titles.name: Ghost of the Seams
titles.description: Patrols look right through you. +1 STE.
